paragraphs: Latest production update: the homepage and /grand-launch are now publicly deployed at findmyinvite.vercel.app, including unlimited ceremony replays until 15 September at 3 AM IST. See PRODUCTION-UPDATE.md; it supersedes older deployed-candidate status below. Custom-domain DNS and catalog publication remain outstanding.

Start with READMECURSOR.md for the mobile/cloud takeover. The team documentation index contains 26 separate role documents, architecture, release/rollback procedures, risks and 15 pre-deployment test cases.

The candidate is deployed at findmyinvite.vercel.app. Guest v1 adds Supabase persistence, private Vercel Blob uploads, recovery links, online RSVP and GitHub Actions deployment. Planned v1.0 launch: 14 September 2026, 11:59 PM IST, subject to release gates. Free creation is planned until 14 October, 11:59 PM IST; no card collection or automatic charge. STATUS.md distinguishes verified infrastructure from remaining domain, catalog, rights, policy and operating blockers.
